messages:
Maya: Quick sync — need to lock the SI handoff cadence + account mapping rules for AtlasOne joint launch and marketplace listing. Proposal below, plz react
Lucas: +1. Can you post the proposed rules? I'll check with AE ops.
Maya: Short proposal:
- Hand-off window: SI claims within 48h of lead ingestion
- Claim precedence: existing AE > SI if AE has active pipeline in 90d
- Reserved accounts: ARR >= 500k flagged for joint outreach
- Marketplace leads: route to SI first if listing metadata matches SI_coverage

Lucas: Solid. One tweak: make claim window 72h for APAC due to timezone ops. Also require SI to log initial contact in CRM within 24h of claim.
Priya: Flag: EU customers with data residency requirements -> require Private deployment escalation. That should block auto-claim; escalate to security/compliance.
Olivia: Ops note: we'll enforce a weekly sweep on Friday 10AM PT to reassign unclaimed leads. Also add automatic tag 'si-claim-pending'.
Maya: Here's a tiny pseudocode for mapping to feed into intake lambda:
```
if account.ARR >= 500000:
  route = 'field_sales_joint'
elif account.region in ['APAC'] and hours_since_ingest < 72:
  route = 'si_first'
elif listing_match == True and si_coverage == 'full':
  route = 'si_first'
else:
  route = 'inbound_q'
```
Lucas: Works. How do we handle duplicate accounts (existing AE but SI wants to pursue)?
Olivia: Rule: AE ownership trumps unless AE opts out in CRM (opt-out tag) or hasn't responded in 5 business days -> auto-escalate to SI.
Priya: Also need to capture legal/contract contact before handoff for gov/midsize accounts.
Maya: Good call. Action items:
- Lucas: update intake lambda with mapping + APAC window by Tue
- Olivia: add weekly sweep workflow & CRM tags
- Priya: draft escalation checklist for data residency + gov accounts
- Maya: schedule 30m handoff playbook walkthrough Wed 11AM PT (invites sent)
IntegrationsBot: Meeting created: 'SI Handoff Playbook — AtlasOne' Wed 11:00 PT — Maya, Lucas, Olivia, Priya
Lucas: :thumbsup: I'll open a short doc in Confluence and link it here when done.
Olivia: I'll add automation to tag leads and run a test ingest tomorrow.
Maya: Thanks all. If nobody objects, we'll promote this pilot next week during partner ops. :rocket:
